name: ModelAngelo
summary: AI-assisted atomic model building from cryo-EM density maps.

steps: Read the maintainer's ModelAngelo installation instructions and check the user's GPU memory and disk capacity before any download.
Review the repository install script and its conda environment changes before running it. Choose a user-controlled cache for the approximately 10 GB of required model/language-model weights.
Run model_angelo build -h in the created environment without downloading research inputs or processing a cryo-EM map.
install.verify_note: Run the maintainer-documented model_angelo build -h check; model-building examples require separate approval and compute.

notes: The installation script and model weights are not vendored or executed by this catalog. GPU compatibility and checkpoint storage require per-host review.
